column1: # fire_rate = shots/second nominal. The fire timer resets to 0 on each shot (Player.ts:86-87), so the real rate
#   is quantised to 60 Hz steps (recomputed 15 Oct 2026 17:25 after the balance pass, 64-bit floats):
#   pistol 20 steps = 3.00/s, smg 10 = 6.00/s, shotgun 31 = 1.94/s, laser 9 = 6.67/s, rocket 40 = 1.50/s,
#   With the speed buff (x1.5): laser 6 steps = 10/s, minigun 3 = 20/s, flamethrower 5 = 12/s.
# Balance pass 15 Oct 2026 (Corne: "guns are just too powerful"): laser 12->7, minigun 20->14, smg 8->6,
#   flamethrower 15->8 per second; ranges cut from 130 (the whole road) to 16-80 so position matters.
# bullet_spread only applies when bullet_count > 1 (BulletManager.ts:24): SMG and minigun fire dead straight.
#   Spread is a lateral velocity of spread_offset * 8 units/s, not an angle.
# grenade bullet_spread 3.0 -> 1.0 (15 Oct): the outer grenades flew off the road and exploded on the grass.
# detonates: 1 = explodes (splash) when it reaches max_range without hitting anything (grenade, rocket).
# max_range: units travelled before despawn. penetration: targets a bullet passes through (1 = stops on first).
# chain_arcs: after a direct hit the shot arcs on to this many more enemies, nearest first, within
#   chain_range of the last one; each jump does less (tuning chain_falloff / chain_min); each gun level
#   adds chain_arcs_per_level arcs (16 Oct, Corne: 100% -> 60% -> 20%, levels add arcs).
